message: Node.js 22 in GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job test) can come with npm 10.5.1 to 10.9.9, none of which supports min-release-age (added in 11.10.0), and job test installs packages with it on line 11; npm before 11.2.0 ignores settings it does not know without a warning
fix: Run npm install -g npm@11.10.0 in job test before it installs packages, or set up a Node.js release that comes with npm 11.10.0 or later (24.14.1 or a later 24.x; 26.0.0 or later)
